key_idea: After j trips the officers have cut the passport into at most j+1 blank gaps, so trip j can be blocked exactly when the remaining p - S_j blank pages fit into j+1 gaps of size at most c_j - 1.
sketch: Scan trips in order keeping the prefix sum S of earlier trips; the first j (0-indexed) with p - S <= (j+1)*(c_j - 1) is the answer, otherwise n. Sufficiency: the adversary can lay the earlier stamps out in any order to realise the layout with j+1 equal-ish gaps, since all earlier trips are guaranteed to fit. O(n). Pitfall: (j+1)*(c-1) reaches 1e23, so use __int128 (or cap the product), and S may exceed p which the same inequality handles.
